note: allow_dirty is set and stated rather than flagged past: the dirty entry is THIS attack being written into the target spike dir. The dependency under measurement, W2_witnessed_trie/trie_witness.py, is untouched by this cycle, and C_reproduces_S79 is the check that matters -- it lands on the committed figures to 0.0 B, which no edit to the prover could survive.

controls.name: C_reproduces_S79
controls.must_fire_because: a refutation must reproduce the target first; if these probes do not land on the committed figures, this attack is about a different measurement and says so instead of publishing
controls.can_fail_because: absent_probes could be seed- or order-dependent, in which case the recomputed means would drift from the committed ones
controls.null_must_contain: a rerun that misses the committed numbers, which would mean the target is not reproducible
controls.detail: recomputed against committed, per set — a gap of 0.0 B on all three is exact reproduction, which is what licenses the refutation below

controls.name: C_proofs_still_verify
controls.must_fire_because: the omitted term must belong to proofs that are REAL: every non-membership proof measured here must verify against the root, or the bytes being counted are bytes of nothing (A29)
controls.can_fail_because: a probe that is actually present has no honest absence proof and prove_non_membership returns None, which would drop n below the probe count
controls.null_must_contain: proofs that fail verification, whose sizes would describe a broken prover
controls.detail: every counted absence proof verifies against the root

controls.name: C_omission_is_structural_not_framing
controls.must_fire_because: the omitted term must be the DIVERGENCE CHILD SET that the model charges, not per-step framing; otherwise this is S77 residual again and not a new finding
controls.can_fail_because: if divergence nodes were single-child, desc_bytes would be ~5 B of framing and the omission would be the naming problem, not a measurement one
controls.null_must_contain: a divergence descriptor whose bytes are all prefix and framing, with no child digests
controls.detail: a 33 B child entry each, so >40 B cannot be framing alone (framing is 5 B + prefix)

falsifiers.name: F_omission_is_negligible
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the omitted descriptor is under 1% of the full proof in every key set
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a corpus whose divergence nodes are narrow, making the omitted term small
falsifiers.detail: omitted descriptor as a percentage of the full proof, per set
falsifiers.refutes: this attack -- if the divergence descriptor is under 1% of the proof, the two accountings differ by nothing that matters and S79 has a naming problem, not a measurement one
falsifiers.fires_when: the omitted descriptor is under 1% of the full proof in every key set
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

no_deps_reason: attacking a committed spike from its own directory
falsifier: the divergence descriptor is under 1% of the proof in every set
